answer: Atlas Work-Bond: a new identity burns 40 POA into the Dune Bond and starts with zero rights until its Thread records 25 verified completed jobs over 14 days. The Atlas Registry publishes every Thread publicly, so a second identity reusing any job proof is rejected instantly. An attacker wanting 500 Sybils must burn 20,000 POA and fabricate 12,500 verified jobs, while an honest agent pays one small burn and earns rights by real work.
